x-e-m2-05.title: Sake rubuta ikirarin cewa yawan zuwa ɗakin karatu yana ƙara maki
x-e-m2-05.goal: Duk lokacin da aka bayyana sabon bayanai, sake yanke shawarar yadda za ka gamsu da ikirarin, sannan ka sake rubuta jimlar ƙarshe.
x-e-m2-05.material: Marubucin shafi yana son rubuta: “Ziyartar ɗakin karatu tana ɗaga maki na ɗalibai.” Mu gwada wannan jimla da bayanan.
x-e-m2-05.prereq.0: Karanta jimlolin Turanci masu sauƙi (matsakaici, maki, ziyartar ɗakin karatu)
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki, zaɓi hukunci mafi dacewa bisa abin da aka sani zuwa yanzu kawai.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, duba ko sabon bayani yana ƙarfafa hukuncin baya ko yana girgiza shi.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunani kan bambancin “canzawa tare” da “canzawa saboda”.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Shin ya dace a rubuta “Ziyartar ɗakin karatu tana ƙara maki” bisa wannan bayanin kaɗai?
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Bayanan sun nuna cewa abubuwan biyu suna canzawa tare kawai. Har yanzu ba mu san ko ɗakin karatu ne dalili ba.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: An tabbatar da cewa ɗakin karatu yana ƙara maki.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Canzawa tare da zama sanadin canji abubuwa ne dabam.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Yawan ziyartar ɗakin karatu da maki suna canzawa tare, amma har yanzu ba mu san dalili ba.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya bambanta alaƙar canzawa tare da dalili.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ziyartar ɗakin karatu ba ta da alaƙa da maki.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Bayanan sun nuna akwai alaƙa. Faɗin cewa babu alaƙa ya saɓa wa bayanan.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yaya hukuncinka zai canza idan aka ƙara wannan bayani?
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan ɗaliban da suke yawan zuwa suna da wasu halaye ma, zai yi wuya a ware ko ɗakin karatu ne ko waɗannan halaye suka kawo bambancin maki.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Wasu dalilai kamar aikin gida da barci za su iya bayyana duka maki da yawan ziyara.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya yi la’akari da yiwuwar akwai wasu bayanai.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Yanzu ya fi bayyana cewa ɗakin karatu ne dalili.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Sabon bayani a maimakon haka ya ƙara wasu bayanai masu yiwuwa.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Bayanan farko ba daidai ba ne.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Sabon bayani bai musanta bayanan farko ba. Ya faɗaɗa fassarar kawai.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yaya za ka tantance jimlar farko da wannan sakamakon gwaji?
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Rukuni da suka ziyarci ya ƙaru da adadi ɗaya da rukunin da ba su ziyarci ba. Wannan gwajin bai tallafa wa jimlar farko ba. Ka kuma tuna cewa ɗan gajeren lokaci iyaka ne.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: An tabbatar cewa ziyartar ɗakin karatu na ƙara maki sosai.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Canjin rukunonin biyu ɗaya ne, maki 1. Rukunin da ya ziyarci bai ƙaru sosai fiye da ɗayan ba.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: A wannan gwajin, ziyara ba ta ƙara maki sosai ba.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya samo asali ne daga kwatanta canjin rukunonin biyu.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Makon huɗu ɗan gajeren lokaci ne, saboda haka ya kamata mu yi hattara, amma bai tallafa wa jimlar farko ba.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan hukunci ya yarda da iyakokin sakamakon, amma ya lura cewa ba ya zama tushen ikirarin.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.reflect: Da farko za ka iya cewa “suna canzawa tare” kawai. Da bayani na biyu wasu bayanai masu yiwuwa suka bayyana, sannan da gwaji na uku jimlar farko ta raunana. Ka yi tunani wane bayani ne ya sauya hukuncinka.
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.prompt: Ka rubuta jimlolin Turanci ɗaya ko biyu da suka fi “ziyartar ɗakin karatu na ƙara maki na ɗalibai” dacewa da bayanan, waɗanda marubucin shafi zai iya amfani da su.
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ware abin da za ka iya cewa da tabbaci da abin da ba ka sani ba daga bayanai ukun.
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Za ka iya amfani da furucin da ke raunana ikirari (mai yiwuwa, bai tabbatar ba, da sauransu).
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Jimlarka ta dace da bayanai ukun duka?
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ikirarin ya fi na asali rauni?
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka kiyaye ɓangaren da tabbatacce ne (canzawa tare)?

x-e-m2-01.s.s2.prompt: Wace hanya ce ta fi dacewa marubucin ya gyara kuskuren?
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko duba ko rubutun ya gaya maka wace daga cikin lambobin biyu daidai ce.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin inda za ka sami bayanin gyara lambar da ba daidai ba.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.o.a: Tabbatar da lambobin ainihi tare da abokan da suka ƙirga buhunan, sannan ka gyara layuka biyun tare.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.r.a: Tambayar mutanen da suka ƙirga da gaske hanya ce ta gyara mai tushe.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.o.b: Canja lambar layi na 3 kaɗai zuwa ƙasa da 18 domin layukan biyu su yi daidai.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.r.b: Ko da lambobin biyun sun yi daidai da juna, idan ba ƙimomin da aka ƙirga da gaske ba ne, bayanin kuskure zai ci gaba da kasancewa.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.o.c: Rubuta 'da yawa' kawai maimakon lamba, domin kawar da yiwuwar kuskure.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.r.c: Kuskuren ya ɓace, amma bayanin rubutun ma ya ɓace.
x-e-m2-01.s.s2.explain: Rubutun kaɗai ba zai gaya maka wace daga cikin lambobin biyu daidai ce ba. Tabbatar da lambar asali tare da mutanen da suka ƙirga, sannan a gyara zuwa daidai, ita ce hanya mai shaida. Sauya zuwa 'da yawa' ma yana kawar da kuskure amma yana rasa bayani.
x-e-m2-01.s.s3.prompt: Abokanka sun bincika, jimillar buhu 30 ce. Sake rubuta layuka na 3 da 4 da Turanci domin lambobin su dace.
x-e-m2-01.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko yanke shawarar buhu nawa aka tattara a awa ta farko, sannan ka rubuta lambar kusa da tabbatacciyar jimilla 30 domin kwatantawa.
x-e-m2-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin jimlar da ta dace da furuci kamar 'in total' ko 'altogether'.
x-e-m2-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Jimlolinka biyu da ka sake rubuta ba sa saɓa wa juna?
x-e-m2-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Lambar awa ta farko na iya zama kowace ƙima matuƙar ba ta wuce 30 ba.

x-e-m2-03.title: Nemo jadawalin da ya cika sharuddan imel ɗin taron ƙungiya
x-e-m2-03.goal: Karanta duk sharuddan imel, ƙirƙiri jadawali daban-daban da suka cika su, sannan ka bayyana sharuddan da ka bincika.
x-e-m2-03.material:
Wannan imel ne daga Hana, shugabar ƙungiyar karatu, zuwa mamba Minho. Rubuta ranaku da lambobi: Mon=1, Tue=2, Wed=3, Thu=4, Fri=5.

Hi Minho,
Mu tsara taron ƙungiyar karatunmu na mako mai zuwa.
1) Za mu haɗu a ranakun aiki, Litinin zuwa Juma'a, amma ba Laraba ba (ina da ziyarar likitan haƙori) kuma ba Juma'a ba (ɗakin karatu yana rufewa da wuri).
2) Makaranta tana ƙarewa da ƙarfe 3 na yamma, saboda haka za mu iya farawa da ƙarfe 3 a farkon lokaci. Ana iya amfani da ɗakin har zuwa ƙarfe 6 na yamma.
3) Taron yana ɗaukar awa 2, kuma koyaushe yana farawa a daidai sa'a.
Aiko mini da ranaku da lokutan farawa da suka dace.
Thanks, Hana

Seoul Table — Abincin Koriya. Manyan jita-jita 12,000 zuwa 16,000 won. Buɗe kowace rana, 11 na safe zuwa 10 na dare. Kusa da Hongdae Station. Teburanmu suna ɗaukar mutane har 6.
